features.title: Canonical Tags — All 119 Public Pages
features.description: Added <link rel="canonical"> to every public HTML page to resolve Google Search Console's 'duplicate without user-selected canonical' warnings
features.details:
scripts/add-canonical-tags.js — New idempotent Node.js script that walks public/ recursively and inserts <link rel="canonical" href="..."> immediately after </title> in every real page. Template fragments (layouts/templates/*, examples/*/template.html) are automatically skipped.

  • Root index.html → https://dommajs.org/
  • Any index.html in a subdirectory → trailing-slash directory URL
  • Non-index .html files → full path with extension
  • Idempotent — safe to re-run; skips files that already have a canonical tag
  • 119 pages injected, 11 template fragments correctly skipped

features.title: Sitemap Rebuild Script
features.description: New script generates public/sitemap.xml from actual HTML files on disk, replacing 30+ phantom URLs with 101 real ones
features.details:
scripts/rebuild-sitemap.js — New Node.js ESM script that walks public/ and generates a valid sitemap.xml from actual HTML files. Uses the same skip rules as the canonical script.

  • Priority tiers: 1.0 (root), 0.8 (top-level hubs), 0.7 (module-level pages), 0.6 (sub-pages), 0.3 (legal)
  • Idempotent — safe to re-run; always regenerates from current file state
  • 101 real URLs replacing the previous sitemap which contained 30+ phantom entries
  • <lastmod> set to today's date on every run

enhancements.title: Blueprint Showcase — Theme Awareness
enhancements.description: Fixed result panes, model state panels, and blueprint method badges to use correct Domma CSS variables instead of hardcoded light-mode colours
enhancements.details:
The showcase's inline <style> block referenced three CSS variables that do not exist in Domma's theme system (--dm-bg-secondary, --dm-bg-tertiary, and a hardcoded #fff fallback), causing all example areas to render with hardcoded light-grey backgrounds regardless of the active theme.

  • .result-pane — var(--dm-bg-secondary, #f8f9fa) → var(--dm-surface-raised)
  • .model-state — var(--dm-bg-tertiary, #e9ecef) → var(--dm-surface-raised)
  • .model-state pre — var(--dm-surface, #fff) → var(--dm-surface)
  • .blueprint-method — removed hardcoded light-mode fallbacks from --dm-primary-bg and --dm-primary
  • .blueprint-code — #282c34 hardcoded background → var(--dm-code-bg, #282c34) so dark themes use the theme's code surface
